responsibility: Declares the Rust AST model for paths and generic arguments used in expressions, patterns, and types. It defines path segments and identifiers, generic bindings and ambiguous const/type generic arguments, plain and qualified path forms (`PathInExpression`, `TypePath`, `QualifiedPathInExpression`, `QualifiedPathInType`), and the helper structures needed to represent namespace- and trait-qualified lookup syntax, so this file owns name/path syntax rather than general expressions or items.
